judgments.supporting_quote: To make sure that the stand-by pumps are ready for operation, start them up once a week.
Pull rear cover out of motor bracket, by which the shaft seal (10) is pulled off the shaft.
the internal liner of the oxygen hose is to be of a material that has an autoignition temperature of not less than 400°C (752°F) in oxygen
The power unit is to be checked for abnormal heating, excessive vibration, or other irregularities
the hydrostatic test is to be conducted on bare pipe ... so that any leakage will be visible
Visual inspections with a borescope allow internal inspections of the surface of ... pumps
Audible and visual alarms are to be fitted ... to warn of the failure of the lubricating oil system
If the rubber bellows is tight, use a fitting tool
